display.purpose: Headline moments only: wordmark, empty-state line, modal/dialog titles, tour heading.

body.purpose: Everything else: paragraphs, buttons, labels, the chat thread.

numeric.purpose: Tabular counts, citation indices, status readouts only.

shadows.name: glow
shadows.purpose: Under primary teal actions and question bubbles — this system's signature depth cue.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Paper surfaces on the cream reading column.

shadows.name: card-dark
shadows.purpose: Elevated surfaces on the night rail.

motion.name: excerpt-settle

motion.name: pulse-dot

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The Ask button — full pill, teal-deep fill, glow shadow.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Summarize, Guide — outline pill on the dark rail.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background:transparent; color:#93A0B8; border:1px solid #2A3348; border-radius:9999px; padding:4px 10px; font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:11px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.04em; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color:#2FD9A8; color:#2FD9A8; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0E7C5F; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Citation Badge
components.description: Signature component: a solid teal pill marking a claim's exact waypoint back to its source.
components.css: .ds-citation-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:2px; background:#0E7C5F; color:#F3F6FB; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-weight:700; font-size:11px; border:none; border-radius:9999px; padding:4px 8px 3px; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-citation-badge::before { content:'\2713'; } .ds-citation-badge:hover { background:#2FD9A8; color:#0E1524; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-citation-badge:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0E7C5F; outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: This replaces the 'Tie-Out Ledger' system (quiet olive/paper accounting world) by explicit user direction: the ledger read as flat and lifeless, and the brief asked for a theme inspired by a bold consumer travel brand — deep navy surfaces, one vivid teal CTA color, warm complementary accents, confident bold type, generous rounding, soft glow instead of hairline rules. Waypoint keeps the product's real mechanism (retrieval-augmented answers with checkable citations) but dresses it the way a travel app dresses a trip: dark hero surfaces, a teal 'go' color, and warmth instead of restraint.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-dark rail (night) holding the document index, paired with a bright cream reading column — high contrast between the two regions, not tonal sameness.
One cool accent (teal) drives every primary action and the citation badge; one warm accent (coral) marks the guided tour and small warmth moments — a deliberate complementary pair.
Generous rounding (12-16px on cards, full pill on buttons and badges) and soft glow shadows replace the ledger's zero-radius, zero-shadow doctrine.
Bold type does real hierarchy work: Syne at 800 weight for headline moments, IBM Plex Sans for everything else, IBM Plex Mono with tabular figures for counts only.
No side-tab borders. Cards get their identity from fill color, radius, and shadow — never a thick colored border on one edge.

rules.name: The Complementary-Pair Rule
rules.body: Exactly two accents exist — teal (cool, primary/action/citation) and coral (warm, tour/highlight only) — chosen as a deliberate complementary pair, never a single muted hue doing all the work.

rules.name: The Headline-Moment Rule
rules.body: Syne is reserved for the handful of places a visitor's eye should land first. It never sets a paragraph, a button label, or the chat thread.

dos: Do keep exactly two accents — teal for action/citation, coral for the tour/highlight only — as a complementary pair.
Do round every card and button; this system has no sharp corners.
Do let question bubbles and the Ask button carry shadow-glow — glow is this system's signature depth cue.
Do reserve Syne for headline moments; body and buttons stay in Plex Sans.
Do guard every animation behind prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add a thick colored border on one edge of a card (a side-tab) — this system gets its identity from fill, radius, and glow instead.
Don't set body copy, chat text, or button labels in Syne.
Don't use coral as small text — it fails contrast; use coral-deep.
Don't let the guided tour block or alter any real upload/ask/document action — it only explains, never intercepts.
Don't imply private accounts or per-user scoping; the corpus stays shared and unauthenticated (unchanged product constraint).
